connectors.evidence_source: The metadata-linked Watchmode API Explorer is live and its provider-owned JavaScript loads this exact OpenAPI artifact. The contract identifies Watchmode API v1.1.7 and declares an API-key header as the recommended authentication method, with Bearer and legacy query-key alternatives. Research was limited to public documentation and the provider artifact; no Watchmode account, credential value, title, streaming source, person, region, network, genre, or other media data was accessed.
connectors.counting_note: The live provider-published OpenAPI artifact contains 23 active HTTP operations across 23 paths. Every operation is GET; there are no deprecated operations or webhook definitions. The result is 23 data actions: 23 reads and 0 writes.
